admission.justification: A unit test proves typing.get_type_hints resolves CheckConfig.targeted_scope instead of failing because the boolean targeted field shadows the targeted module.

applicability: Class-scope type annotation resolution on CheckConfig in code_quality/quality_plan.py.
conditions: Runtime or static callers resolve annotations on CheckConfig via typing.get_type_hints.
statement: CheckConfig keeps its public targeted and targeted_scope fields while importing the targeted module under an alias so typing.get_type_hints resolves targeted_scope in class scope.
title: CheckConfig aliases quality_targeted for targeted_scope type hints
